name: General Discusion
description: A standard template for general discussions, focusing on key points and supporting notes.

sections.title: Summary
sections.instruction: Provide a brief, one-paragraph executive summary of the entire meeting.  Focus on the most relevant a key points from the discussion.

sections.title: Key Points
sections.instruction: Create a bulleted list of the key points from the discussion.

sections.title: Follow Ups
sections.instruction: List all follow up tasks. Always add reference transcript segment and timestamp.
